events.event: Polri said the officer identified only as TK in the Prabowo wiretapping case is a Brigadier General (Brigjen) now being examined by Propam, and Kapolri told Komisi III that suspect Irjen Ahrie Sonta allegedly ordered TK to carry out the surveillance.
events.key_numbers: 4 senior officers named suspects (Listyo Sigit Prabowo, Ahrie Sonta, Eko Hadi Santoso, Slamet Uliandi) · 3 detained at Mako Brimob Kelapa Dua · Slamet Uliandi not detained (recovering from stroke) · Sigit removed from KSP post on 4 Nov
events.why_it_matters: The case over spying on the President now reaches a serving general, showing how deep the alleged surveillance chain goes inside Polri.
events.spreading_evidence: detik terpopuler #2 on 13 Nov 04:05 WIB; also covered by Tribun, Liputan6, Kumparan, Viva

events.event: Polri spokesperson Brigjen Trunoyudo Wisnu Andiko said Jokowi's diploma was already forensically tested by Puslabfor, recorded in a berita acara pro justitia and handed to prosecutors, so no new test is needed, rejecting the request of Roy Suryo's team.
events.key_numbers: Request letter sent 11 Nov to Jakarta Timur District Court judges · 3 comparison diplomas from Nov 1985 requested · Puslabfor result itself not disclosed
events.why_it_matters: The diploma dispute is in court and this decides whether the physical diploma gets re-examined in the Roy Suryo trial.

events.event: TurnBackHoax (Mafindo) rated false a video claiming the Kapolri stated foreign parties were involved in the wiretapping of President Prabowo, and a claim that Jokowi raged over Gibran being disqualified by the MK.
events.key_numbers: 5 [SALAH] ratings on 11-12 Nov, 4 of them political · also false: Bahlil involved in wiretapping, Titiek Soeharto agreeing to cash-out MBG
events.why_it_matters: Hoaxes are piggybacking on the wiretapping and Gibran stories, so viewers should check claims before sharing.
events.spreading_evidence: TurnBackHoax front page, 4 political hoaxes in 2 days

events.event: BNPB stopped water-bombing operations against karhutla in South Kalimantan, citing a sharp drop in fires and heavier November rain, and shifted firefighting to ground teams.
events.key_numbers: Two helicopters crashed during operations (Mi-17V5 in Seruyan, Central Kalimantan; EC225LP Super Puma in Barito River) · Earlier BNPB totals as of 8 Nov: 1,051 hotspots, 4,486 ha burned, of which Central Kalimantan 3,904 ha
events.why_it_matters: Haze season is shifting to rainy season in Kalimantan, but fires are still rising in Papua Selatan and Sultra.

events.event: Headlines reported karhutla hotspots rising 146% in Southeast Sulawesi (BNPB deploying 35 units) while BNPB had earlier reported a 66% rise in Papua Selatan, even as Kalimantan cools down.
events.key_numbers: Sultra hotspots +146% · 35 units deployed · Papua Selatan +66% (earlier report) · another report cited +94% with 342 hotspots (not reconciled)
events.why_it_matters: Fires are moving east to Sulawesi and Papua after Kalimantan, so haze risk is not over.

events.event: CNBC Indonesia reported that OJK has revoked the licences of 16 BPR/BPRS rural banks in 2026 up to 3 November, the latest being BPR Agritrans Batumarta in South Sumatra, with LPS chair Anggito Abimanyu blaming weak governance.
events.key_numbers: 16 banks closed Jan-3 Nov 2026 · by month: Jan 2, Feb 2, Mar 2, Apr 1, Jun 1, Jul 3, Aug 1, Sep 3, Nov 1 · West Java 4 closures, West Sumatra 3
events.why_it_matters: Savers wonder whether their money is safe; LPS guarantees deposits up to Rp2 billion per customer per bank.
events.spreading_evidence: CNBC Indonesia headline list 11 Nov 22:24 WIB (popular block did not load)

events.event: Yogyakarta police released 154 of 157 people detained after the 10 November protest that turned violent at the DPRD DIY office.
events.why_it_matters: Shows how the 10 November protest ended and how many people were actually held.

events.event: A 9-year-old boy died after his electric bicycle collided with a truck in Madura, a story on detik's most-read list.
events.why_it_matters: Child e-bike safety is a recurring concern for parents, but this is a single local incident with no details checked.
